title: calamagrostis neglecta var. pooides
intro: Calamagrostis neglecta var. pooides, commonly known as Poverty grass, is a species of grass within the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Poverty grass include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, making it a useful treatment for respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Calamagrostis neglecta var. pooides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
